# Finch · Gewohnheiten

Erstellt: 14.09.2026, 03:09

## **Inhalt** {#toc}

- [Preis und Paywall](#theme-pricing_paywall)
- [Werbedruck](#theme-ads)

## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 06.08.2026 - 12.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Darlingwhatever_, 12.09.2026, 1/5: "I didn’t pay to play through a movie trailer. I pay for the premium version of this app and enjoy using it for it’s intended purpose, I like the monthly supply of new content to dress my bird and decorate his home. Two months of the last year that content has been tie-ins to an upcoming movie. It feels greedy to push premium on people and then the benefits of their premiums subscription is being forced to learn about a movie they’re paying you to sell us. Supergirl and Forgotten Island collabs were a bad idea."
            2. _Samanticss_, 11.09.2026, 1/5: "The ONLY thing that kept me opening the app and checking off tasks every day was to try and get the month’s micropet. Now it’s behind a $40-120 paywall… and the main feature of every screen is many lock graphics🔒. I used to be a paid user but fell on hard times. I guess that means I deserve progressively worse service from a self care app I’ve used almost every day for three years. Squeezing from both ends with all these corporate sponsors too… and I heard you’re not good to your designers. Sell out. Edit: putting custom symbols for tasks behind a paywall is honestly ableist. And the message is so vague…like custom icons on a list are one of the most basic features. And every time I click to do it, a nonspecific add to pay $40 for an app I’ve used almost every day for 5 years. I used this to help me through my day. I can’t believe you took away such basic features with no warning or community note…"
            3. _mysticalgamer666_, 06.08.2026, 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Werbedruck** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Werbedruck.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen werbedruck.
      Review-Fenster: 10.09.2026 - 10.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer spüren Werbedruck. Das signalisiert Monetarisierungsreibung und eine Öffnung für einen saubereren Wettbewerber.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _spudd122_, 10.09.2026, 4/5: "I’ve really loved this app for over 2 years now. It’s been helpful for building good habits and staying on top of self-care and mental health. However, the month long events turning into a month long advertisement for an upcoming movie every few months is getting annoying and old quick. I understand this app is free, but forcing month long ads on your customers shouldn’t be the way to pay for it. Ads annoy people and they’ll stop using your product to avoid them."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 28.05.2026 - 02.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Landorous_, 02.09.2026, 1/5: "This whole event is a glitchy mess. I can’t imagine how bad the movie will be. This applies to all."
            2. _anonymousical_, 02.09.2026, 1/5: "trying to charge me almost $40 after i deleted the app for a plan i never chose and now i can’t even download any apps until i pay for the yearly plan for a useless and pointless app just so i can download other apps. 1 star all the way. never has had this issue before until one. if i can give a zero rating i would. useless and money hungry people and app"
            3. _plantguyhome_, 28.05.2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
<!--/ir-theme-->
